# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Monday, October 26, 2026

*Tuesday, Oct 27, 2026 edition. Indian prices are Monday's (26 Oct) close. Gold spot, MCX gold and Brent are this morning's early-Asia prints. Muthoot Fincorp Ltd is a separate company from Muthoot Finance Ltd; Muthoot Finance appears here as a listed lender.*

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

**1. The market punished NBFCs that guided to higher credit costs or thinner margins. Shriram fell to an 11-month low and Five-Star dropped 7.45%, even though both reported profit growth.**
- **Shriram Finance** cut its FY27 AUM growth guidance to **15–17% from 18%**, citing the weak monsoon and geopolitical uncertainty, and flagged stress among borrowers in drought-hit regions. The stock fell as much as **6.13% to ₹810.20** intraday, its eighth straight losing session. Jefferies cut its target to ₹1,145 (from ₹1,210) and JM Financial to ₹1,025 (from ₹1,175); both kept Buy. Jefferies said credit costs could stay elevated for **one to two more quarters** as stress builds in Maharashtra, Karnataka and Telangana. ([Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/shriram-finance-stock-hits-11-month-low-as-growth-outlook-cut-credit-costs-weigh-brokerages-slash-target-price-14059892.html))
- **Five-Star Business Finance:** Q2 PAT was **₹299 cr (+4.61%)**, but that includes a **₹19 cr one-time tax benefit**, and PBT fell 2% to ₹375 cr. Management expects its cost of funds to rise "amid the tightening rate cycle". Rate increases on new loans took effect from October to protect NIM, which held at 19.87%. The stock closed at **₹414.85 (−7.45%)** on BSE. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/stocks/five-star-business-finance-share-price-q2-results-net-profit-up-5-on-higher-nii-aum-expands-14-20019803.htm))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** This quarter, investors are pricing the credit-cost line and the funding-cost outlook more than headline profit. Muthoot Fincorp has no listed equity, but NCD investors and rating agencies read the same signals.


**2. Fed decision on Wednesday. Spot gold is hovering just above $4,000, and markets price an 82% chance of a US rate *hike* in December.**
- Spot gold was **$4,013.70/oz (−0.1%)** at 06:15 IST. Traders price about an **11%** chance of a hike this week and **82%** for December (CME FedWatch). ([Business Times/Reuters](https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/companies-markets/energy-commodities/gold-eases-stronger-us-dollar-weighs-fed-meeting-focus))
- On Friday gold touched **$3,975**, its lowest since 20 July. ([BusinessLine live](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-26-october-2026/article71622964.ece))
- MCX gold was **₹1,43,150/10g (+0.05%)** at 07:11 IST. ([Makro](https://makro.live/mcx-gold-silver-price))
- Brent was **$114.99** in early Asia, after shedding almost 1% on Monday. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/commodities/crude-oil-prices-brent-wti-us-iran-war-west-asia-russia-strait-of-hormuz-supply-usd115-saudi-houthi-attacks-20019831.htm))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** The loan-to-value cushion on gold loans and NBFC funding costs are both tied to this week's Fed outcome; a hawkish Fed would tend to weaken gold and lift Indian yields at the same time. The 10-year G-sec closed at **7.4740%** on Friday, after the longest weekly run of rising yields since 1998 (Reuters, via the [BusinessLine live blog](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-26-october-2026/article71622964.ece)).

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market

- **Tranche I public NCD issue (open 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026).** Bids stood at 0.99 times the ₹200 cr base issue at 16:58 on 26 Oct, up from 0.55× on Friday: retail 0.75×, HNI 1.36×, non-institutional 0.80×, institutional 0.00×. The issue is ₹200 cr base plus ₹300 cr green shoe, allotted first come, first served, and closes Thu 5 Nov. ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/))
- **Subsidiary rating.** CareEdge Global reaffirmed Muthoot Microfin, Muthoot Fincorp's listed microfinance subsidiary, at **CareEdge BB-** and revised the outlook to **Positive from Stable** on its **USD 50 mn ECB programme** (USD 15 mn existing, including a GIFT City-listed ECB, plus USD 35 mn proposed). The agency said the rating factors in "expected support from parent Muthoot Fincorp Limited, which holds a **50.2%** stake" and "the parent's enhanced financial flexibility to provide support". Cited data: GNPA was **3.7%** at 30 Jun 2026, against 4.8% at Mar-25, and FY26 credit cost was 3.0% (7.5% in FY25). ([EquityBulls](https://www.equitybulls.com/news/377689/muthoot-microfin-earns-positive-outlook-from-careedge-global-on-stronger-asset-q), [NSE filing](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/muthootmicrofin_26102026101916_MMLCareEdgeGlobalPressReleaseSD.pdf))
- Despite the outlook change, Muthoot Microfin shares traded at **₹147.40, down more than 4%**, at 11:05 IST. ([BusinessLine live](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-26-october-2026/article71622964.ece))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** the agency cites the parent's capacity to support the subsidiary as a reason for the Positive outlook, which also implies an expectation of support from Muthoot Fincorp.

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

- **Monday 26 Oct close:** Sensex **73,606.75 (+482.92, +0.66%)**, Nifty **22,753.20 (+153.20, +0.68%)**. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-26-october-2026/article71622964.ece), [NSE index closes](https://archives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_26102026.csv))
- **Financials lagged:** Nifty Financial Services **24,454.35 (+0.21%)**, Nifty Bank 54,366.70 (+0.15%). ([NSE index closes](https://archives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_26102026.csv))
- **NBFC peers (NSE close):**
  - Manappuram Finance **₹287.50 (+0.49%)**, after an intraday low of ₹270.85
  - Muthoot Finance **₹2,395.80 (+0.96%)**
  - IIFL Finance **₹529.20 (−0.46%)**
  - Shriram Finance **₹825.00 (−4.62%)**, the top Nifty loser
  - Bajaj Finance **₹918.70 (−1.10%)**
  - ([exa.ai NSE closes](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/MANAPPURAM?exchange=XNSE&date=2026-10-26&view=daily))
- **Flows (26 Oct, provisional):** FII **−₹1,462.49 cr**, DII **+₹2,609.57 cr**. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/fiis-sell-rs1462-crore-diis-buy-rs2610-crore-as-market-ends-higher-20019660.htm))
- **Rupee:** closed at **95.19/$ (−25 paise)**, its third straight fall, on oil and importer demand. BusinessLine/PTI's provisional close was 95.22. ([Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/banks/rupee-falls-for-third-straight-session-ends-at-95-19-as-oil-prices-and-importer-demand-weigh-14060401.html))

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

- **RBI: no new Notification or circular after 23 Oct.** The latest items are bank-only (operational-risk capital, CA Eleventh Amendment) plus the FEMA compounding delegation. ([RBI Notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx), [Circular index](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_CircularIndexDisplay.aspx))
- **RBI press releases, 26 Oct:** routine items only, namely the G-sec auction, ODI data for September, money-market operations and the result of the 4-day VRR. ([RBI press releases](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx))
- **RBI drafts:** nothing after 11 Sep. ([Drafts](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/DraftNotificationsGuildelines.aspx))
- **SEBI:** the latest circular is still dated 23 Oct. **IBBI:** nothing since 24 Sep. ([SEBI](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0), [IBBI](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars))
- More detail on the Rules page.

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

- **Five-Star Business Finance, Q2 FY27** ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/stocks/five-star-business-finance-share-price-q2-results-net-profit-up-5-on-higher-nii-aum-expands-14-20019803.htm)):
  - AUM **₹14,640 cr (+14% YoY, +7% QoQ)**; disbursements **₹2,078 cr** (₹1,196 cr a year ago).
  - NII ₹691 cr (+11.5%); RoE 15.25%.
  - Incremental borrowing cost 8.43%; book cost of funds 8.78%.
- **Aavas Financiers, Q2:** PAT **₹182 cr (+11%)**, NII +10%. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/earnings/aavas-financiers-q2-results-net-profit-rises-11-to-rs182-crore-nii-grows-10-20019648.htm))
- **Poonawalla Fincorp:** its board approved NCDs aggregating **₹2,000 cr** (15:22 IST). ([BusinessLine live](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-26-october-2026/article71622964.ece))
  - **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** another NBFC is raising debt while Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCD issue is open, adding to retail NCD supply.
- **Results calendar:**
  - PTC India Financial today, **27 Oct**.
  - **Cholamandalam** and **PNB Housing** on **28 Oct**.
  - **Muthoot Microfin** (Muthoot Fincorp subsidiary) on **5 Nov**.
  - ([StockWatch – PFS](https://www.stockwatch.live/in/news/ptc-india-financial-services-pfs-board-to-consider-q2-h1-fy27-results-on-oct-27-35c6a2bf-368e-4599-8bc6-ee80975a7a0c), [StockWatch – Chola](https://www.stockwatch.live/in/news/cholamandalam-investment-trading-window-closed-for-q2-results-31e0d9f9-df8c-475f-a63b-f38a4cb6db50), [AlphaStreet – PNB Housing](https://alphastreet.com/india/pnb-housing-finance-ltd-pnbhousing-earnings-call-invite-for-the-2nd-quarter-and-half-year-ended-september-30-2026/), [StockFin – Muthoot Microfin](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/MUTHOOTMF/2026-10-23/board-meeting))

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

- **Muthoot Microfin (Muthoot Fincorp subsidiary):** CareEdge Global reaffirmed BB- and moved the outlook to **Positive** on its USD 50 mn ECB programme (see the Muthoot Fincorp section). This is the same company CRISIL upgraded to AA-/Stable in June 2026. ([EquityBulls](https://www.equitybulls.com/news/377689/muthoot-microfin-earns-positive-outlook-from-careedge-global-on-stronger-asset-q))
- **Muthoot Fincorp ratings unchanged:**
  - CRISIL AA/Stable and Brickwork AA+/Stable on Tranche I ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)).
  - CARE AA/Stable from 5 Oct ([CARE PR](https://www.careratings.com/upload/CompanyFiles/PR/202610121058_Muthoot_Fincorp_Limited.pdf)).

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

- **PFC–REC merger:** the Centre is considering preference shares so that it keeps at least **51%** of the merged entity. The proposal is with the Finance Ministry ahead of Cabinet, and the merger is targeted for 1 Apr 2027. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/pfc-rec-merger-moves-closer-as-centre-weighs-preference-shares-to-retain-51-stake-20019578.htm), [Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/finance-ministry-reviewing-pfc-rec-merger-cabinet-approval-soon-14060348.html))
- **Bank of Baroda:** its subsidiary bob Securities & Giltedge has begun NBFC operations as an NBFC-ND-ICC. ([ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/banking/bank-of-barodas-subsidiary-bob-securities-giltedge-commences-nbfc-operations/135212900))

## 💻 Digital & Fintech

- No significant developments today.

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

- **Rural and drought stress is showing up in the numbers.**
  - **Shriram:** analysts expect credit costs to stay high for one to two quarters. JM Financial calls the "deteriorating asset quality indicators" the key concern. ([Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/shriram-finance-stock-hits-11-month-low-as-growth-outlook-cut-credit-costs-weigh-brokerages-slash-target-price-14059892.html))
  - **Five-Star** is the counterpoint. 30+ DPD fell to **11.50%** (from 12.38%), credit cost was **1.80%** (from 1.85%) and GS3 was **3.48%**. Its Stage 3 PCR is only **39.49%**. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/stocks/five-star-business-finance-share-price-q2-results-net-profit-up-5-on-higher-nii-aum-expands-14-20019803.htm))
- **Gold-loan stress:** covered in the deep dive below.

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

- No significant developments today.

## 🏘️ Sector Deep Dive — Tuesday: Gold loan sector

### The stress is starting at the borrower, and the gold isn't the problem yet

**1. "Secured" no longer automatically means "safe".** Moneycontrol's 26 Oct explainer pulls the Q2 warnings together. ([Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/commodities/why-are-nbfcs-flagging-stress-in-gold-loans-despite-a-rush-to-expand-14060075.html))
- Shriram (23 Oct) joined other NBFCs in flagging a rise in gold-loan bad loans, and delinquencies are higher in **EMI-based** gold-loan accounts.
- **Bajaj Finance's Rajeev Jain** prefers a "longer tenor bullet model" over short-tenor, high-LTV schemes, "even if it comes at a slower growth".
- **Piramal's Jairam Sridharan** estimated that **15–23%** of FY26 industry gold-loan disbursements, around **₹4.7 lakh cr**, went to borrowers who were 90+ days overdue on at least one other loan. He added that Piramal's own exposure to such borrowers is under 1% of its October disbursements, and that the figure does not mean those loans have gone bad. ([ET, 22 Oct](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/india-gold-loan-boom-rbi-regulations-borrower-stress-default-risks-nbfc-growth/articleshow/135113574.cms))

**2. The book is still growing fast** ([ET, 22 Oct](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/india-gold-loan-boom-rbi-regulations-borrower-stress-default-risks-nbfc-growth/articleshow/135113574.cms)):

| Metric | Figure | Source note |
|---|---|---|
| Bank loans against gold jewellery | ₹5.52 lakh cr, +88.1% YoY (31 Jul 2026) | RBI data, via ET |
| NBFC gold loans | ~₹3.6 lakh cr, +69% YoY (31 Aug) | Reuters, via ET |
| Share of non-housing retail lending | ~28% (Macquarie) | via ET/TOI |
| Market forecast | >₹30 lakh cr by Mar-2028 (ICRA) | via ET |

**3. New entrants are adding capacity just as the cycle turns** (all via [ET, 22 Oct](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/india-gold-loan-boom-rbi-regulations-borrower-stress-default-risks-nbfc-growth/articleshow/135113574.cms)):
- Tata Capital (88.6% of Yogakshemam Loans) and Godrej Capital (Kanakadurga's gold book) bought their way in during July.
- Aditya Birla Capital is targeting 200–300 gold branches by Mar-27; L&T Finance plans 500 this year.
- **The RBI framework in force since 1 Apr 2026:** LTV of 85% up to ₹2.5 lakh, 80% for ₹2.5–5 lakh and 75% above that, with consumption bullet loans capped at **12 months**.

**4. Collateral is the second line of defence, and it held this week.**
- Gold is around 5% off its October record (Brickwork's Rajeev Sharan) and sits just above $4,000/oz. ([BusinessLine live](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-26-october-2026/article71622964.ece))
- Macquarie's warning is about a *combination*: a sharp price fall alongside rising defaults, which forces bulk auctions and weaker realisations. ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/india-gold-loan-boom-rbi-regulations-borrower-stress-default-risks-nbfc-growth/articleshow/135113574.cms))

> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Piramal's "90+ DPD elsewhere" metric and the focus on EMI and short-tenor gold products are likely analyst questions for gold lenders, including Muthoot Fincorp. More gold branches from ABCL, L&T, Tata and Godrej add pricing pressure in the southern markets where Muthoot Fincorp holds **62.33 t** of pledged gold (Mar-26, per [CARE](https://www.careratings.com/upload/CompanyFiles/PR/202610121058_Muthoot_Fincorp_Limited.pdf)).

reports.title: What changed in the rules
reports.content:
# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Tuesday, 27 October 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

No new RBI/SEBI circulars or regulatory changes related to NBFCs were found today.

There is no new RBI Notification, Circular or Master Direction dated 24–27 Oct. The Notifications page's latest block is still **23 Oct**: `RBI/2026-2027/297` (banks' Capital Adequacy Eleventh Amendment), `/298` (FEMA compounding delegation) and `/299` (banks' Forthcoming Instructions Second Amendment, on operational risk). None of them is addressed to NBFCs. RBI's Monday output was routine market operations. SEBI's latest circular is still 23 Oct, IBBI has nothing since 24 Sep, and RBI drafts haven't moved since 11 Sep. **`RBI/2026-27/296` (19 Oct, UAPA 1267 list)** is still the last NBFC-addressed RBI instrument.

### What is in the market that is *not* an NBFC circular

| Item | What it actually is |
|------|---------------------|
| **RBI press releases, 26 Oct 2026:** G-sec auction notice, ODI data for September 2026, money-market operations, and the 4-day VRR auction result | Market operations and data releases. None of them is a Direction. [RBI press releases](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx) |
| **RBI Notifications, 23 Oct** (`/297`, `/298`, `/299`) | Commercial-bank capital and operational-risk amendments, plus a FEMA compounding delegation. [RBI Notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx) |
| **Q2 results commentary** (Shriram, Five-Star, CreditAccess; see Daily Watch) | Company guidance on credit cost. Not regulation. |
| **SEBI circulars** | 23 Oct (research-analyst call records) and 22 Oct (EPI margin waiver). Neither is NBFC or NCS-specific. [SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0) |
| **RBI drafts** | The latest is still **11 Sep** (KYC). The Interest Rate Directions draft (**12 Aug**) and the revolving-credit draft (**6 Aug**) are still pending. [Drafts](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/DraftNotificationsGuildelines.aspx) |
| **IBBI** | Latest circulars are **24 Sep**. [IBBI circulars](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars) |

Primary sources checked this morning (IST):
- [RBI Notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx): latest block 23 Oct.
- [RBI Press Releases](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx): latest 26 Oct (routine).
- [RBI Drafts](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/DraftNotificationsGuildelines.aspx): latest 11 Sep.
- [SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0): latest 23 Oct.
- [IBBI circulars](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars): latest 24 Sep.

---

## ⏰ What did *not* move overnight

| Item | Status | Next date |
|------|--------|-----------|
| **Q2 FY27 / LODR 52** | Books frozen at 30 Sep. | **14 Nov 2026** (18 days) |
| **Credit Risk-o-Meter** | Issued 7 Oct; goes live 45 days later. | **21 Nov 2026** (25 days) |
| **SNFA / IRAC 3rd Amendment** | Live since 1 Oct. Gold jewellery is **not** SNFA. | Legacy reversal by **30 Sep 2027** |
| **SC repossession judgment (16 Sep)** | Still no RBI circular. | Watch DoR/DoS |
| Revolving-credit draft (6 Aug) | Still a draft. | Final expected around Nov 2026 |
| Interest Rate Directions draft (12 Aug) | Comments closed 11 Sep. | **1 Apr 2027** if finalised |
| Recovery agents (RBC 3rd Amendment) | Certification, calling window, call recording. | **1 Jan 2027** (66 days) |
| Type I deregistration / NBFC-AA interoperability | Window open. | **31 Dec 2026** (65 days) |
| Repo | **5.50%** (unchanged since the October MPC). | Next MPC |

---

## 📅 Regulatory calendar

- **14 Nov 2026:** last date for Q2 FY27 results of listed debt issuers under SEBI LODR Regulation 52.
- **21 Nov 2026:** SEBI Credit Risk-o-Meter disclosure applies to new debt offer documents.
- **31 Dec 2026:** Type I NBFC deregistration / NBFC-AA interoperability window closes.
- **1 Jan 2027:** recovery-agent requirements under the RBC Third Amendment take effect.
- **1 Apr 2027:** Interest Rate Directions take effect, if finalised.
- **30 Sep 2027:** last date to reverse unrealised pre-SNFA interest on legacy SNFA stock.
